title.en: An Act Granting Gratuity to the Heirs of the Late Representative Atanacio Mapping and Appropriating Funds for the Purpose

text.en: The legal heirs of the late Representative Atanacio MAPPING, who was among those killed in the sinking of S.S. Corregidor, are hereby given a gratuity of fifteen thousand pesos.
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of fifteen thousand pesos for the purpose indicated in the preceding section.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
